parameters.query:
SELECT challenge_id, delivery_email, one_time_code, challenge_expires_at, proposal_id, proposal_version, payload_hash, proposal_payload
FROM scopeledger.request_manager_publication(
  $1::uuid,
  $2::jsonb,
  now() + make_interval(hours => $3::integer),
  $4::text
);

parameters.subject: ={{ 'ScopePilot manager approval code — proposal v' + $json.proposal_version }}
parameters.message:
={{ 'A ScopePilot proposal is awaiting your approval.

Proposal ID: ' + $json.proposal_id + '
Version: ' + $json.proposal_version + '
Payload SHA-256: ' + $json.payload_hash + '
Expires: ' + $json.challenge_expires_at + '

One-time approval code: ' + $json.one_time_code + '

Confirm only after reviewing the exact proposal payload in the manager form. ScopePilot will never ask you to send this code by email.' }}
